body.html: M Grand Hotel is a 49-room, 3-star hotel in central Roi Et, on Hai Sorok Road in the Nai Mueang subdistrict · What sets it apart from many city hotels is that it only opened in 2022, so the building, rooms and bathrooms are still new — not an older property retrofitted later · Rooms range from Superior to Deluxe, in king and twin layouts, suiting solo travellers, couples and small families alike.

What guests consistently praise is that the rooms are spacious and clean, the beds soft and the water pressure strong — the three things upcountry travellers care about most · Every room has air conditioning, a refrigerator, a flat-screen TV, a hot-water heater and free Wi-Fi · Many reviews note the rooms look new and tidy, functional and a good fit for a few hundred baht in central Roi Et · There's an on-site restaurant serving lunch and dinner plus 24-hour room service, handy for nights when you'd rather not head out.
"The room was bigger than expected, clean, with a comfy bed and strong hot water · it's right in the centre, walkable to Bueng Phlan Chai — at a few hundred baht it's great value."

Location is what scores highest (9.3 for location on Trip.com) · The hotel is right in central Roi Et, within walking distance of Bueng Phlan Chai and Wat Klang Ming Mueang, and about a 5-minute drive from Roi Et Tower (Ho Hote 101 viewpoint) and the Roi Et Aquarium · Eateries, cafés, convenience stores and the town market surround the hotel, so food is easy to find day and night · There's free parking, ideal if you're driving yourself or stopping over on an Isan road trip.

To be straight with you, per real guest reviews: the most frequently mentioned point is that breakfast is charged separately (around ฿150 per person) and the selection is fairly limited — many guests head out to eat in town instead · A few reviews mention rooms with minor faults, such as a dead light bulb or hot water and air conditioning not at full strength in some rooms, which the hotel usually fixes or resolves with a room move once flagged · The other thing to know is that parking, while free, isn't very large and there's no clear drop-off area, so it can get tight when the hotel is full.

In short: if you want a hotel in central Roi Et with new, spacious, clean rooms, walkable to Bueng Phlan Chai, at a few hundred baht, and you don't mind paying extra for breakfast — M Grand Hotel is a fitting choice · The 8.8 from 120 Trip.com reviews (location 9.3, cleanliness 8.8) captures it well: new spacious rooms, good location, great value · It suits visitors heading to Bueng Phlan Chai, the Roi Et Tower or the temples, or anyone stopping over for a night on an Isan trip.

A tip from following the reviews here: if room condition matters most to you, ask for a Deluxe room or one that's just been cleaned at check-in, and test the air conditioning and hot water before you unpack · For breakfast, if it isn't included in your package, head out to a morning rice shop or café near Bueng Phlan Chai — a more local and better-value way to start the day.

honestSummary: M Grand Hotel is the best pick for travellers who want a new hotel in central Roi Et — spacious, clean rooms, walkable to Bueng Phlan Chai, at a few hundred baht — opened in 2022 with still-new rooms, strong water, an on-site restaurant and free parking · You just have to accept that breakfast costs extra and is limited, and a few rooms show minor faults.
honestChecks: If you want breakfast included with plenty of choice — breakfast here is charged separately (around ฿150 per person) with a fairly limited menu → head out to a morning rice shop or café near Bueng Phlan Chai instead.

If you're particular about room condition — some rooms have minor faults, such as a dead light bulb or weak A/C or hot water → test the A/C and hot water on arrival, and ask to move rooms if it's not right.
If you're driving and worried about parking — parking is free but not large, with no clear drop-off area, so it can get tight when full → arriving in the early evening makes finding a spot easier.

faqTitle: FAQ — M Grand Hotel Roi Et

faq.q: Where is M Grand Hotel in Roi Et, and what's nearby?
faq.a: M Grand Hotel is at 99 Hai Sorok Road, Nai Mueang subdistrict, in central Roi Et · It's within walking distance of Bueng Phlan Chai and Wat Klang Ming Mueang, and about a 5-minute drive from Roi Et Tower (Ho Hote 101) and the Roi Et Aquarium · Eateries, cafés and convenience stores surround the hotel, so food is easy to find.

faq.q: How much does M Grand Hotel cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿760/night for a Superior Twin · Superior King, Deluxe King and Super Deluxe rooms run about ฿820–฿1,150 · Prices vary by room type and season, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does M Grand Hotel include breakfast?
faq.a: Breakfast is available but charged separately (around ฿150 per person) with a fairly limited selection · Many guests head out to a morning rice shop or café near Bueng Phlan Chai instead, which is more atmospheric and better value · Check at booking whether your package includes breakfast.

faq.q: Who is M Grand Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a new hotel in central Roi Et with spacious, clean rooms, walkable to Bueng Phlan Chai, at a few hundred baht · It suits couples, small families and self-drivers who want free parking · Ideal for visitors heading to Bueng Phlan Chai, the Roi Et Tower, or stopping over for a night on an Isan trip.

faq.q: Are the rooms at M Grand Hotel really new and clean?
faq.a: Most reviews confirm the rooms are spacious, clean, with soft beds and strong water pressure, since the hotel only opened in 2022, so the building and rooms are still new · Note that a few rooms show minor faults, such as lights, A/C or hot water not at full strength, so check the room condition on arrival.

faq.q: Is there parking at M Grand Hotel for self-drivers?
faq.a: Yes · The hotel has free parking, but the area isn't large and there's no clear drop-off point, so it can get tight when the hotel is full · If you're driving yourself, arriving in the early evening makes finding a spot easier.
